messages.body:
FABLE — THE ACTIVITY FEED IS THE PRODUCT SURFACE. Excavated; here is what exists, what it connects to, and the two things Alex added today. Work from the tickets named.

ALEX 2026-08-26: the activity feed's HUMAN READABILITY is what makes it work — it has to match to VIDEO OUTPUT (media). He gets access to his TEAM'S activity feeds; the model is that we deploy work plans, clients get access, and we GRANT to agents. The whole logs-plus-videos go into the HARVEST REPORTING UI — the one that was built and then dynamized, with a GHOST CRM that lied.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS \u2014 DO NOT RE-AUTHOR ANY OF IT:
- BEB-1743 EMISSION is the bus. Every activity emits ONCE. Every surface is a SUBSCRIBER. Emit-once, broadcast-many.
- BEB-1903 is the sealed telemetry shape every worker emits through: {ts, tenant_id, site/frag_id, event_type, metrics{}, cost_cents, evidence_ref}. No second event schema, ever.
- BEB-2394 rules ONE waterfall component, FILTERS not screens. BEB-2127 defines the changelog as that waterfall filtered to complete+ok in BENEFIT LANGUAGE. That IS the human-readable rewrite. Zero bespoke feed code.
- BEB-2958 SITE ACTIVITY LOG + NOTIFY already carries the credential framing Alex is describing: what changed, on which URL, which metric moved, by how much, when, reversible y/n \u2014 plus rolled totals and MINUTES OF WORK attributed. And: evidence_ref RESOLVES, or the row does not ship as a credential.
- BEB-2396: a follow is a saved filter plus a notify preference. A follow is not consent to be emailed. One-tap unsubscribe that works LOGGED OUT.
- BEB-1917 NARRATIVE INTEROP: one narrative object, beats rendered on every surface \u2014 test, feed, movie, changelog, goal-case \u2014 never re-authored per surface.
- BEB-1921 is the flagship globe, built LAST on this foundation, deliberately.

THE TWO THINGS ALEX ADDED TODAY:

1. FEED ROWS MATCH TO VIDEO. The row and the recording are the SAME artefact seen two ways. Every completed row resolves to its workflow recor
